decisions.evidence: The bound observed carrier cites the Rang–Angermann title but its NTNU URL opens Minchev–Wright, A review of exponential integrators for first order semi-linear problems (cover). Independently opened DML scan: cover identifies Rang–Angermann; section 2, printed pp. 386–387, gives shifted Rosenbrock stages and exact/approximate/arbitrary-W order conditions. Replaced only the incorrect URL; current proof/definition and prerequisites independently checked as recorded in the report. Claim and dependency interfaces unchanged.
